description: This file defines the RepostItemValuation class and related functions for handling item valuation reposting in an ERP system, including validation, status management, reposting logic, error handling, and scheduled execution.

classes.name: RepostItemValuation
classes.description: A Document class representing an item valuation reposting record with methods for validation, status management, and reposting logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the repost item valuation document, setting status and company info.

methods.name: reset_field_values
methods.description: Resets item_code and warehouse fields based on the 'based_on' attribute.

methods.name: set_company
methods.description: Sets the company attribute based on voucher or warehouse.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the document, optionally writing to the database.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Enqueues the repost job when the document is submitted.

methods.name: restart_reposting
methods.description: Resets reposting state to queued and updates the database.

methods.name: deduplicate_similar_repost
methods.description: Marks similar reposts as skipped to avoid duplication.
